claims.statement: Jupiter is god of the sky and thunder and king of the gods.
claims.statement_id: Jupiter adalah dewa langit dan guntur serta pemimpin para dewa.
claims.quote: is the god of the sky and thunder, and king of the gods.

claims.statement: Jupiter was the leading deity of Roman state religion in the Republican and Imperial eras.
claims.statement_id: Jupiter adalah dewa utama agama negara Romawi pada zaman republik dan kekaisaran.
claims.quote: Jupiter was the chief deity of Roman state religion throughout the Republican and Imperial eras

claims.statement: The thunderbolt and eagle are Jupiter's emblems.
claims.statement_id: Petir dan elang merupakan lambang Jupiter.
claims.quote: His identifying implement is the thunderbolt and his primary sacred animal is the eagle

claims.statement: Romans viewed Jupiter as a counterpart of Greek Zeus.
claims.statement_id: Orang Romawi memandang Jupiter sebagai padanan Zeus Yunani.
claims.quote: The Romans regarded Jupiter as the equivalent of the Greek Zeus

claims.statement: The title Jupiter Optimus Maximus expressed Jupiter's supreme status.
claims.statement_id: Gelar Jupiter Optimus Maximus menyatakan kedudukan Jupiter sebagai dewa tertinggi.
claims.quote: Jupiter's most important title was Jupiter Optimus Maximus, meaning the Best and Greatest and signifying his role as father of the gods.

claims.statement: Jupiter was held to protect Rome in war and preserve welfare in peace.
claims.statement_id: Jupiter dipercaya melindungi Roma dalam perang dan menjaga kesejahteraan saat damai.
claims.quote: He protected Rome in time of war and maintained the welfare of the people during peace.

claims.statement: Jupiter is depicted with a white beard and an eagle on his scepter.
claims.statement_id: Jupiter digambarkan berjanggut putih dan memiliki lambang elang pada tongkat.
claims.quote: He was most often portrayed with a long, white beard, and his symbol was the eagle atop a scepter

claims.statement: North African Ammon was equated with Jupiter as Jupiter Ammon.
claims.statement_id: Ammon dari Afrika Utara disamakan dengan Jupiter sebagai Jupiter Ammon.
claims.quote: The Romans considered the revered North African oracle Ammon an embodiment of Jupiter, and referred to this syncretic dual divinity as Jupiter Ammon.

claims.statement: Ganesha is an important Hindu deity.
claims.statement_id: Ganesha termasuk dewa penting dalam agama Hindu.
claims.quote: Ganesha (also Ganesa or Ganapati) is one of the most important gods in Hinduism.

claims.statement: Ganesha is depicted with an elephant head and human body.
claims.statement_id: Ganesha digambarkan dengan kepala gajah dan tubuh manusia.
claims.quote: Ganesha is easily recognized with his elephant head and human body

claims.statement: Ganesha is patron of writers, travellers, students, and commerce, and removes obstacles.
claims.statement_id: Ganesha melindungi penulis, pengelana, pelajar, dan perdagangan serta menyingkirkan rintangan.
claims.quote: Ganesha is the patron of writers, travellers, students, and commerce, and he removes obstacles blocking new projects.

claims.statement: Ganesha is Shiva and Parvati's son and receives offerings before important undertakings.
claims.statement_id: Ganesha adalah putra Shiva dan Parvati dan diberi persembahan sebelum tugas penting dimulai.
claims.quote: The potbellied, elephant-headed Hindu god Ganesha, son of Shiva and Parvati, is venerated throughout India. He is believed to bestow success and abundance through his removal of obstacles. Before any important task is begun, an offering is made to Ganesha.

claims.statement: In one story Shiva had Ganesha's head replaced with an elephant's.
claims.statement_id: Dalam suatu kisah, Shiva mengganti kepala Ganesha dengan kepala gajah.
claims.quote: Repentant, Shiva ordered a new head to be found for the boy and, as the first animal available was an elephant, so Ganesha gained a new elephant head

claims.statement: Ganesha is also worshipped in Jain and Buddhist traditions.
claims.statement_id: Ganesha juga dipuja dalam tradisi Jain dan Buddha.
claims.quote: Ganesha is also worshipped as a principal deity in both Jainism and Buddhism.

claims.statement: In a museum sculpture Ganesha holds a lasso, axe, sweet, and one of his tusks.
claims.statement_id: Pada patung museum Ganesha memegang tali, kapak, manisan, dan gadingnya sendiri.
claims.quote: Here, his upper left hand holds a lasso; the upper right, a battle-ax; the lower left, a sweet; and the lower right, one of his own tusks

claims.statement: Hindu texts mention Ganesha between the first century BCE and the second century CE.
claims.statement_id: Teks Hindu menyebut Ganesha antara abad pertama sebelum Masehi dan abad kedua Masehi.
claims.quote: Ganesha is mentioned in Hindu texts between the 1st century BCE and 2nd century CE

claims.statement: Michael, also called Archangel Michael or Michael the Taxiarch, is an archangel and the warrior of God in Judaism, Christianity, and Islam, and is venerated as a saint in some Christian traditions.
claims.statement_id: Michael, juga disebut Archangel Michael atau Michael the Taxiarch, adalah malaikat agung dan pejuang Tuhan dalam agama Yahudi, Kristen, dan Islam, dan dihormati sebagai orang kudus dalam sebagian tradisi Kristen.
claims.quote: Michael, also called Archangel Michael or Michael the Taxiarch, is an archangel and the warrior of God in Judaism, Christianity, and Islam while additionally being venerated as a saint in some Christian traditions.

claims.statement: The earliest surviving mentions of his name are in third- and second-century BC Jewish works, where he is chief of the angels and archangels.
claims.statement_id: Penyebutan nama Michael tertua yang masih ada terdapat dalam karya-karya Yahudi abad ke-3 dan ke-2 SM, yang menyebutnya pemimpin para malaikat dan malaikat agung.
claims.quote: The earliest surviving mentions of his name are in third- and second-century BC Jewish works, often but not always apocalyptic, where he is the chief of the angels and archangels

claims.statement: He is the guardian prince of ancient Israel, responsible for the care of the Israelites.
claims.statement_id: Ia adalah pangeran pelindung Israel kuno dan bertanggung jawab memelihara bangsa Israel.
claims.quote: he is the guardian prince of ancient Israel and is responsible for the care of the Israelites

claims.statement: The Book of Enoch lists Michael as one of seven archangels, with Uriel, Raguel, Raphael, Sariel, Gabriel, and Remiel.
claims.statement_id: Kitab Henokh (Book of Enoch) mendaftar Michael sebagai salah satu dari tujuh malaikat agung, bersama Uriel, Raguel, Raphael, Sariel, Gabriel, dan Remiel.
claims.quote: The Book of Enoch lists Michael as one of seven archangels (the remaining names are Uriel, Raguel, Raphael, Sariel, Gabriel, and Remiel)

claims.statement: In Islam, Michael, or Mīkāʾīl, is one of the four archangels along with Jibril (Gabriel), with whom he is often paired, Israfil, and Azrail.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Islam, Michael atau Mīkāʾīl adalah salah satu dari empat malaikat agung bersama Jibril (Gabriel), yang sering dipasangkan dengannya, Israfil, dan Azrail.
claims.quote: In Islam, Michael, or Mīkāʾīl, is one of the four archangels along with Jibril (Gabriel, with whom he is often paired), ʾIsrāfīl (trumpeter angel) and ʿAzrāʾīl (angel of death).

claims.statement: In Islamic literature, Michael is associated with mercy and asks God for forgiveness for humans.
claims.statement_id: Dalam literatur Islam, Michael dikaitkan dengan rahmat dan memohon ampun kepada Tuhan bagi manusia.
claims.quote: In further Islamic literature, Michael is associated with mercy. He asks God for forgiveness for humans

claims.statement: As the angel who carries out God's providence, he is associated with natural phenomena and causes rain upon the lands.
claims.statement_id: Sebagai malaikat pelaksana pemeliharaan Tuhan, ia dikaitkan dengan gejala alam dan menurunkan hujan ke daratan.
claims.quote: As the angel to effectuate God's providence he is also associated with natural phenomena and causes rain upon the lands.

claims.statement: Unlike in Christian tradition, in Islam Michael is rarely portrayed as a warrior angel.
claims.statement_id: Berbeda dengan tradisi Kristen, dalam Islam Michael jarang digambarkan sebagai malaikat pejuang.
claims.quote: Unlike Christian tradition, Michael is rarely portrayed as a warrior-angel

claims.statement: The Hebrew name Michael means "Who is like God?"; he is one of the principal angels, and his name was the war-cry of the good angels in the battle in heaven.
claims.statement_id: Nama Michael dalam bahasa Ibrani berarti "Who is like God?" (Siapa yang seperti Allah?); ia salah satu malaikat utama, dan namanya menjadi seruan perang para malaikat baik dalam pertempuran di surga.
claims.quote: (Hebrew "Who is like God?"). St. Michael is one of the principal angels; his name was the war-cry of the good angels in the battle fought in heaven against the enemy and his followers.

claims.statement: According to the Catholic Encyclopedia, Christian tradition gives Michael four offices, including fighting against Satan and rescuing the souls of the faithful from the power of the enemy, especially at the hour of death.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Catholic Encyclopedia (Ensiklopedia Katolik), tradisi Kristen memberi Michael empat tugas, antara lain melawan Satan dan menyelamatkan jiwa orang beriman dari kuasa musuh, terutama pada saat kematian.
claims.quote: Following these Scriptural passages, Christian tradition gives to St. Michael four offices: To fight against Satan. To rescue the souls of the faithful from the power of the enemy, especially at the hour of death.

claims.statement: Michael is the champion of God's people, the Jews in the Old Law and the Christians in the New Testament, and therefore the patron of the Church.
claims.statement_id: Michael adalah pembela umat Tuhan, orang Yahudi dalam Hukum Lama dan orang Kristen dalam Perjanjian Baru, sehingga ia menjadi pelindung Gereja.
claims.quote: To be the champion of God's people, the Jews in the Old Law, the Christians in the New Testament; therefore he was the patron of the Church

claims.statement: In art, Michael is represented as an angelic warrior fully armed with helmet, sword, and shield, standing over the dragon, which he sometimes pierces with a lance.
claims.statement_id: Dalam seni, Michael digambarkan sebagai malaikat pejuang bersenjata lengkap dengan helm, pedang, dan perisai, berdiri di atas naga yang kadang ditusuknya dengan tombak.
claims.quote: In art St. Michael is represented as an angelic warrior, fully armed with helmet, sword, and shield (often the shield bears the Latin inscription: Quis ut Deus), standing over the dragon, whom he sometimes pierces with a lance.

claims.statement: He also holds a pair of scales in which he weighs the souls of the departed.
claims.statement_id: Ia juga memegang timbangan untuk menimbang jiwa orang yang telah meninggal.
claims.quote: He also holds a pair of scales in which he weighs the souls of the departed

claims.statement: The Greek Liturgy styles him Archistrategos, "highest general".
claims.statement_id: Liturgi Yunani menyebutnya Archistrategos, "panglima tertinggi" (highest general).
claims.quote: The Greek Liturgy styles him Archistrategos, "highest general"

claims.statement: In Normandy, Michael is the patron of mariners at his famous sanctuary at Mont-Saint-Michel in the Diocese of Coutances.
claims.statement_id: Di Normandia, Michael adalah pelindung para pelaut di tempat sucinya yang terkenal di Mont-Saint-Michel, Keuskupan Coutances.
claims.quote: In Normandy St. Michael is the patron of mariners in his famous sanctuary at Mont-Saint-Michel in the Diocese of Coutances.

claims.statement: Well known is the apparition of Michael (a. 494 or 530-40) at his renowned sanctuary on Monte Gargano, as related in the Roman Breviary.
claims.statement_id: Terkenal kisah penampakan Michael (tahun 494 atau 530-40) di tempat sucinya yang termasyhur di Monte Gargano, sebagaimana diceritakan dalam Brevir Romawi (Roman Breviary).
claims.quote: Well known is the apparition of St. Michael (a. 494 or 530-40), as related in the Roman Breviary, 8 May, at his renowned sanctuary on Monte Gargano

claims.statement: Early Christians gave Michael the care of their sick; in Phrygia, where he was first venerated, his prestige as angelic healer obscured his role in military affairs.
claims.statement_id: Pemeluk Kristen awal menyerahkan perawatan orang sakit kepada Michael; di Frigia (Phrygia), tempat ia pertama dihormati, kemasyhurannya sebagai penyembuh malaikat mengalahkan perannya dalam urusan militer.
claims.quote: but to St. Michael they gave the care of their sick. At the place where he was first venerated, in Phrygia, his prestige as angelic healer obscured his interposition in military affairs.

claims.statement: St. Basil and other Greek Fathers, as well as Salmeron and Bellarmine, place Michael over all the angels.
claims.statement_id: St. Basil, para Bapa Gereja Yunani lain, Salmeron, dan Bellarmine menempatkan Michael di atas semua malaikat.
claims.quote: St. Basil (Hom. de angelis) and other Greek Fathers, also Salmeron, Bellarmine, etc., place St. Michael over all the angels

claims.statement: Early Jewish writings, and very frequently the Book of Enoch, designate Michael as "the prince of Israel".
claims.statement_id: Tulisan Yahudi awal, dan sangat sering Kitab Henokh (Book of Enoch), menyebut Michael "the prince of Israel" (pemimpin Israel).
claims.quote: Michael is specially designated in early Jewish writings and very frequently in the Book of Enoch as "the prince of Israel"

claims.statement: As "the advocate of the Jews", Michael is represented as the angel of forbearance and mercy.
claims.statement_id: Sebagai "the advocate of the Jews" (pembela orang Yahudi), Michael digambarkan sebagai malaikat kesabaran dan belas kasihan.
claims.quote: "the advocate of the Jews." It is for this reason that he is represented as the angel of forbearance and mercy

claims.statement: Michael is opposed particularly to Samael, Israel's accuser; his enmity with Samael dates from when Samael was thrown down from heaven.
claims.statement_id: Michael bermusuhan terutama dengan Samael, penuduh Israel; permusuhan itu bermula ketika Samael dicampakkan dari surga.
claims.quote: particularly with Samael, Israel's accuser. His enmity with Samael dates from the time when the latter was thrown down from heaven.

claims.statement: In Arabic literature Michael is called "Mika'il" or, in the Koran, "Mikal", and he is one of the four archangels.
claims.statement_id: Dalam literatur Arab, Michael disebut "Mika'il" atau, dalam Al-Qur'an (Koran), "Mikal", dan ia salah satu dari empat malaikat agung.
claims.quote: Michael is called in Arabic literature "Mika'il" or (in the Koran) "Mikal." He is one of the four archangels

claims.statement: In the Haggadah, Michael is represented as the most prominent of the archangels.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Haggadah, Michael digambarkan sebagai malaikat agung yang paling menonjol.
claims.quote: Michael should be represented in the Haggadah as the most prominent of the archangels

claims.statement: According to the Jewish Encyclopedia, the idea that Michael is the Charon of individual souls, common among Christians, is not found in Jewish sources.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Jewish Encyclopedia, gagasan bahwa Michael adalah pengantar (Charon) jiwa-jiwa perorangan, yang umum di kalangan Kristen, tidak ditemukan dalam sumber Yahudi.
claims.quote: The idea that Michael is the Charon of individual souls, which is common among Christians, is not found in Jewish sources

claims.statement: According to Revelation, there was war in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon, and the dragon and his angels fought.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Kitab Wahyu (Revelation), terjadi perang di surga: Michael dan para malaikatnya berperang melawan naga, dan naga beserta malaikat-malaikatnya berperang.
claims.quote: And there was war in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon; and the dragon fought and his angels,

claims.statement: The great dragon, that old serpent called the Devil and Satan, who deceives the whole world, was cast out into the earth.
claims.statement_id: Naga besar itu, ular tua yang disebut Iblis (Devil) dan Satan, yang menyesatkan seluruh dunia, dicampakkan ke bumi.
claims.quote: And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth

claims.statement: In the Book of Daniel, Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help the messenger who remained there with the kings of Persia.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Kitab Daniel, Michael, salah satu pemimpin utama (chief princes), datang menolong utusan yang tertahan di hadapan raja-raja Persia.
claims.quote: but, lo, Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me; and I remained there with the kings of Persia.

claims.statement: At that time Michael shall stand up, the great prince who stands for the children of thy people.
claims.statement_id: Pada waktu itu Michael akan bangkit, pemimpin agung (great prince) yang membela anak-anak bangsamu.
claims.quote: And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which standeth for the children of thy people

claims.statement: According to the Epistle of Jude, Michael the archangel, when contending with the devil about the body of Moses, did not dare bring a railing accusation against him, but said, "The Lord rebuke thee."
claims.statement_id: Menurut Surat Yudas (Epistle of Jude), Michael sang malaikat agung, ketika berbantah dengan Iblis tentang jenazah Musa (body of Moses), tidak berani menghujatnya, tetapi berkata, "The Lord rebuke thee."
claims.quote: Yet Michael the archangel, when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses, durst not bring against him a railing accusation, but said, The Lord rebuke thee.

claims.statement: According to St. Thomas, Michael is the prince of the last and lowest choir, the angels.
claims.statement_id: Menurut St. Thomas, Michael adalah pemimpin paduan terakhir dan terendah, yaitu para malaikat.
claims.quote: But, according to St. Thomas (Summa Ia.113.3) he is the prince of the last and lowest choir, the angels.

claims.statement: The Hebrew name מִיכָאֵל, romanized Mīḵāʾēl, literally means 'Who is like El [God]?'.
claims.statement_id: Nama Ibrani (Hebrew) מִיכָאֵל, dilatinkan Mīḵāʾēl, secara harfiah berarti 'Who is like El [God]?' (Siapa yang seperti El [Allah]?).
claims.quote: Hebrew: מִיכָאֵל, romanized: Mīḵāʾēl, lit. 'Who is like El [God]?'

claims.statement: In European folklore vampires are undead humanlike creatures.
claims.statement_id: Dalam cerita rakyat Eropa vampir adalah makhluk mirip manusia yang hidup kembali.
claims.quote: In European folklore, vampires are undead humanoid creatures that visit loved ones and cause mischief or deaths in the neighbourhoods they inhabited while they were alive.

claims.statement: A vampire was believed to leave the grave at night to drink living people's blood.
claims.statement_id: Vampir diyakini keluar dari kubur malam hari dan mengisap darah orang hidup.
claims.quote: In the first-mentioned meaning a vampire is usually supposed to be the soul of a dead man which quits the buried body by night to suck the blood of living persons.

claims.statement: Reported anti-vampire measures included staking, beheading, or burning the corpse.
claims.statement_id: Penangkal vampir mencakup pasak pada jasad, pemenggalan kepala, atau pembakaran tubuh.
claims.quote: To put a stop to his ravages, a stake is driven through the -corpse, or the head cut off, or the heart torn out and the body burned

claims.statement: Polish burials had sickles or stones placed on the bodies.
claims.statement_id: Makam di Polandia ditemukan dengan sabit atau batu yang ditaruh di tubuh jasad.
claims.quote: They all had either sickles placed across their neck or body or large rocks stacked under their chin

claims.statement: Vampire scares often followed contagious deaths and further deaths nearby.
claims.statement_id: Kepanikan vampir sering mengikuti kematian akibat penyakit menular dan kematian beruntun.
claims.quote: vampire scares usually began when a person died – often of a contagious disease, and in New England almost always of tuberculosis – and others in the vicinity began dying

claims.statement: Bram Stoker's Dracula appeared in 1897 and influenced the vampire image.
claims.statement_id: Novel Dracula karya Bram Stoker diterbitkan pada tahun 1897 dan berpengaruh pada citra vampir.
claims.quote: the pre-eminent vampire novel in history: Dracula by Bram Stoker, published in 1897.

claims.statement: Ares is a Greek god of war and courage, an Olympian and son of Zeus and Hera.
claims.statement_id: Ares adalah dewa perang dan keberanian Yunani, salah satu dewa Olimpus dan putra Zeus serta Hera.
claims.quote: is the Greek god of war and courage. He is one of the Twelve Olympians, and the son of Zeus and Hera.

claims.statement: Ares is an Olympian deity associated with war and courage.
claims.statement_id: Ares adalah dewa Olimpus yang berkaitan dengan perang dan keberanian.
claims.quote: ARES was the Olympian god of war, battlelust, courage and civil order.

claims.statement: Ancient art shows Ares armored with helmet, shield, and spear.
claims.statement_id: Ares digambarkan memakai zirah dan ketopong serta membawa perisai dan tombak.
claims.quote: In ancient Greek Archaic and Classical art, Ares is most often depicted wearing full armour and helmet and carrying a shield and spear.

claims.statement: Hephaistos trapped Ares and Aphrodite in a golden net.
claims.statement_id: Hephaistos menjebak Ares dan Aphrodite dalam jaring emas.
claims.quote: Ares had an adulterous affair with the goddess Aphrodite but her husband Hephaistos trapped the pair in a golden net

claims.statement: Twin giants confined Ares in a bronze vessel until Hermes freed him.
claims.statement_id: Raksasa kembar mengurung Ares di bejana perunggu sampai Hermes membebaskannya.
claims.quote: They imprisoned the god in a bronze jar (or cauldron) for one year and he was only freed through the intervention of Hermes.

claims.statement: Romans identified Mars with Ares.
claims.statement_id: Orang Romawi menyamakan Mars dengan Ares.
claims.quote: The Romans identified their god Mars with the Greek Ares.

claims.statement: Ancient depictions show Ares as a bearded warrior or a helmeted youth with spear.
claims.statement_id: Penggambaran kuno Ares dapat berupa prajurit dewasa berjanggut atau pemuda berketopong dan tombak.
claims.quote: In ancient Greek art he was depicted as either a mature, bearded warrior armed for battle, or a nude, beardless youth with a helm and spear.
